name: theme-service
description: Create WCAG 2.2 AA compliant dark/light themes and install them into any repo, new or legacy. A theme that fails contrast is never written. Includes the Claude Code skill (and AGENTS.md) for creating, applying, and updating themes. Version is tracked in the VERSION file.

scripts.install-all: node install/install.mjs --builtins true --only theme-service && npm run build-themes
scripts.//release: Bump VERSION + prepend CHANGELOG.md + tag vX.Y.Z. Commit feature work FIRST — it refuses on a dirty tree. Usage: npm run release <patch|minor|major> -- --note "what changed"   (--note is required; the -- is what passes it through npm. Flags: --allow-dirty, --yes)
scripts.//test: Unit tests: the contrast checker (library + CLI), the AA pairs both builders share (tools/palette-checks.mjs), and both builders refusing to write a failing theme. Node's built-in runner finds every *.test.mjs; no dependencies.
scripts.//dev:install-pages-skill: MAINTAINER ONLY. Links a11y-way-pages/skill into ~/.claude/skills/a11y-way-pages, globally for every repo on this machine, from THIS clone — so you can drive the header/footer skill against the brand site you are editing, which is the reference implementation its docs point at. Leaves the theme-service skill's link untouched. The install-* scripts above deliberately install theme-service ONLY: a theme user never needs this skill.
scripts.//dev:overview-site: MAINTAINER ONLY. Local dev of the A11Y Way brand site (a11y-way-pages/site/overview.html + preview.html). Nothing here is needed to install or use the theme service.
